preconditions.description: The size of the first part of the graph is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The size of the second part of the graph is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= a and 1 <= y <= b for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects a vertex in the first part to a vertex in the second part, with valid indices.

postconditions.description: The minimal number of colours used is between 1 and the number of edges inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in edge_colors)
postconditions.description: Each edge is assigned a color between 1 and the minimal number of colors inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(edge_colors[i] != edge_colors[j] for i in range(m) for j in range(i + 1, m) if (edges[i][0] == edges[j][0] or edges[i][0] == edges[j][1] or edges[i][1] == edges[j][0] or edges[i][1] == edges[j][1]))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent edges have the same color.
